entry.name: universal
entry.digest: Send messages to all objects of the same type
entry.description: Sends a input message to all instances of the same class of object in a patcher. The order in which the messages arrive is not defined.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: If a 1 is present as an argument,will send messages it receives to objects of the specified class in subpatchers of its patcher as well as in the patcher containing theobject.
